board: M5Stack ENV III Unit (SKU U001-C, SHT30 + QMP6988, HY2.0-4P Grove)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run: the SHT30 0x2400 reply with Sensirion CRCs and the QMP6988 at 0x70 (OTP coefficients plus the datasheet's Tr/Pr polynomials, solved rather than linearised) decode to the exact slider values. Supply is limited to 3.0-3.6 V because the unit's SDA/SCL pull-ups go to the Grove supply pin, so 5 V would put 5 V on the I2C lines.
